e505b4cc273074d6.column_purpose: Primary key. Code of the form <molecule_id>_<atom_number>, e.g. TR024_11 = atom 11 of molecule TR024. Referenced by connected.atom_id and connected.atom_id2, which record bonds between atoms.

bcc3d5ac9a5afa9c.column_purpose: Chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase (h, c, o, n, cl, br, si, p, zn, ...). 21 distinct elements; hydrogen and carbon dominate, consistent with organic molecules.

1ac905d0799311fd.column_purpose: Foreign key to molecule.molecule_id; the molecule this atom belongs to. Matches the prefix of atom_id.

7337f4f2da7de8fd.column_purpose: Primary key. Composite code: molecule_id plus the two atom indices joined by the bond (e.g. TR031_18_36 = bond between atoms 18 and 36 of molecule TR031).

303f441666ad475a.column_purpose: Bond order in chemical notation: '-' single bond (10528), '=' double bond (1844), '#' triple bond (6).

a47146ee67a738ae.column_purpose: Foreign key to molecule.molecule_id; the molecule containing this bond. 444 distinct molecules.

f8efc74d45d5778f.column_purpose: Identifier of the first atom in the connected pair; references atom.atom_id. Format <molecule code>_<atom index> (e.g. TR018_11).

2eee15d5c20fae51.column_purpose: Identifier of the second atom in the connected pair; references atom.atom_id. Same format as atom_id.

e54e4c3d305e0035.column_purpose: Identifier of the bond connecting the two atoms; references bond.bond_id. Format <molecule code>_<atom1 index>_<atom2 index> (e.g. TR018_11_12).

84ae7d8a7f910b0a.column_purpose: Binary class label of the molecule, encoded as '-' (191 molecules) and '+' (152 molecules). The exact semantic of the classes (e.g., positive/negative in a classification task such as mutagenicity or toxicity) is not determinable from the data alone; the '+'/'-' encoding strongly suggests a two-class target variable. No joined columns provide further evidence, so this reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.
